item.title: AI extracts interpretable constitutive laws directly from solid-mechanics data
item.description: Researchers at the Eastern Institute of Technology (EIT), Ningbo, have developed a graph-based approach that directly extracts concise, accurate constitutive equations from solid-material experimental data. item.title: Electrical pulses convert PFAS waste into valuable silver fluoride
item.description: Fluorinated waste, like that found in firefighting aqueous film-forming foam, can act as a significant environmental pollutant.
